movie.title: Nimrods
movie.overview: Three friends journey from Kansas City to Los Angeles, mistakenly believing that their band is opening for Green Day on New Year’s Eve.

alternativeTitles.title: New Year's Rev: A Green Day Story

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: Convinced they've landed the ultimate gig opening for Green Day, three naive Kansas City bandmates embark on a chaotic cross-country road trip to Los Angeles for New Year's Eve.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: Three ambitious friends from Kansas City pack up their gear and set out on a cross-country journey to Los Angeles, fully convinced their band has secured a dream slot opening for Green Day on New Year’s Eve. Unbeknownst to them, the gig is based on a massive misunderstanding, turning their hopeful road trip into a test of friendship and resilience. Along the highway, they face hilarious mishaps, personal conflicts, and the stark reality of the music industry. Ultimately, the trio must reckon with their shared passion for music and discover what truly holds them together.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: In the heart of Kansas City, three best friends and aspiring musicians spend their days rehearsing in garages and dreaming of making it big in the music industry. Their lives take a sudden, dramatic turn when they misinterpret a vague message, leading them to believe they've been selected to open for punk rock legends Green Day at a massive New Year’s Eve show in Los Angeles. Driven by adrenaline and blind optimism, the trio crams their gear into a beaten-up van and hits the open road without a second thought. As they trek across the American West, the journey quickly unravels into a comedy of errors, featuring mechanical breakdowns, sketchy roadside encounters, and dwindling cash reserves. Internal tensions begin to flare as physical exhaustion sets in and subtle hints about the gig's true nature start to surface. Despite growing doubts, their shared love for music and deep-rooted camaraderie keep them pushing westward toward the California coast. Along the way, each member is forced to re-evaluate their personal ambitions, maturity, and loyalty to one another. By the time they arrive in the bustling streets of Los Angeles, the reality of the situation hits them, prompting an unforgettable New Year's Eve revelation. Ultimately, the trial of the road transforms them from wide-eyed dreamers into a tighter-unit band, leaving them with a newfound appreciation for the journey itself.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: Nimrods follows three close-knit friends and musicians from Kansas City who embark on a wildly optimistic road trip across the United States. Bound for Los Angeles, the trio is fueled by the mistaken belief that they have landed a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to open for Green Day at a high-profile New Year’s Eve concert. Blending comedy, drama, and a pulse of rock music, the story explores the hilarious and heartfelt realities of big dreams, cross-country travel, and enduring friendship as the band confronts the truths of growing up and making art together.
